label: Northstar representative retail-media demo scenarios
budgetCurrency: EUR in campaign console; product prices remain sample USD
limitations: Budgets and schedules are stored but not enforced by ad serving.
No auctions, billing, pacing or campaign purchase attribution.
Impressions count served responses, not verified views.
Algolia controls candidate ranking; overlapping categories can produce competing demo ads.
Inactive states and frequency caps do affect ad eligibility.
